raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Integrate FlashInfer's capacity-bounded SM100 BF16 rank-major MegaMoE backend into SGLang's DeepSeek-V3 expert-parallel path. The integration targets the low-latency TP8/EP8 deployment coordinate implemented by https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/4810 and fails closed for unsupported model or parallelism settings. Each rank passes its actual active slice of 1–128 tokens, and all eight ranks must use the same active-row count for a launch.

This PR corresponds to the validated SGLang integration head
`3fa9c343c4724a93b494d569a780a726c238dff6`, which includes upstream main
`afe90a8bc908002219993794404c7c95dd3ced1d`, and FlashInfer head
`466998f16191cda80fb531f0268ccd536b3def16`. Its resolved tree is
`7de16a817c506acf967b42f24e8c9bbecb1b9209`.

Dependency: this integration requires the FlashInfer API in
[FlashInfer PR #4810](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/4810),
which is not yet merged. Tests below use that exact dependency commit, not a
released FlashInfer wheel. Enable the adapter with
`--moe-a2a-backend flashinfer_megamoe --moe-runner-backend auto` in the
supported unquantized BF16 TP8/EP8 configuration.

## Modifications

- Add `flashinfer_megamoe` as an explicit MoE A2A backend and validate its fixed TP8/EP8, BF16, static-expert-placement contract during server-argument resolution.
- Convert loaded canonical BF16 expert weights into the FlashInfer layer, transfer weight ownership after preprocessing, and use FlashInfer's session-owned 128-row capacity buffers without SGLang-side staging or padding.
- Route the fused dispatch, expert compute, and combine path through FlashInfer while retaining SGLang's shared-expert computation.
- Split eager prefills into rank-synchronous chunks of at most 128 tokens and pass each actual 1–128-row slice directly to FlashInfer; no synthetic padding rows are dispatched.
- Support admitted CUDA graph buckets without allocator work during capture while preserving the same active-row count across ranks.
- Add focused server-argument, active-slice, weight-build, warmup, chunking, capture-state, and graph-contract tests.

## Accuracy Tests

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| Current-head CPU integration | Passed: 14 tests, 200 deselected, at the exact SGLang head above |
| Exact dependency/model gate | Passed: source imports, model verification, and matched serving settings |
| Real-model paired probes | Passed: identical token IDs for both 32-token probes; maximum output-logprob deltas `0.0039856611` and `0.0001090435` |
| GSM8K 8-shot | Passed: `1245/1311 = 0.9496567505720824`, strictly above `0.935` |

Validation completed on 2026-09-10 using one x86_64 node with eight B200
GPUs and real `ModelCloud/DeepSeek-V3-0324-BF16` weights at revision
`2e840f66bd45f87e2078d0972405e53dc26672c1`. All 163 weight shards were
verified. Comparison `1917124.10` used the exact SGLang and FlashInfer heads
above. Deterministic probes used 1000- and 1024-token inputs and 32 output
tokens each; output token IDs matched, while logprobs were not bit-identical.

Formal GSM8K `1917124.19` used 8 shots, temperature 0, seed 20260827, and
a 512-token output limit, evaluating all 1311 examples. Its authorization
job `1917640` was submitted with literal Slurm dependency
`--dependency=afterok:1917639`; validator `1917639` verified the qualifying
comparison `1917124.10` before authorization. Only then was the formal GPU
evaluation submitted.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Status: **passed at the exact validated heads above**. The baseline uses
DeepEP plus DeepGEMM; the candidate changes the routed-expert path to
FlashInfer MegaMoE with matched TP8/EP8 serving, memory, and graph settings.
Each row completed its full request count without errors. The established
acceptance criteria are candidate/baseline >=0.95 for every row and >=1.00
by geometric mean. These are serving throughput measurements, not kernel-only
timings.

| Workload | Input → output tokens | Requests | Concurrency | Metric | Baseline | FlashInfer MegaMoE | Speedup |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Prefill | 1024 → 1 | 16 | 1 | Input tokens/s | `3639.680149` | `4650.939306` | `1.277842864`× |
| Decode | 32 → 256 | 16 | 1 | Output tokens/s | `66.766437` | `64.940911` | `0.972658025`× |
| Mixed | 1024 → 128 | 32 | 8 | Total tokens/s | `1772.745784` | `2253.482340` | `1.271181892`× |
| **Summary** |  |  |  |  |  |  | **`0.972658025`× minimum / `1.164702769`× geomean** |

Prefill and mixed throughput improve by 27.78% and 27.12%, respectively.
Decode throughput is **2.73% lower**, within the established 5% per-workload
gate; this PR does not claim a decode speedup. Geometric-mean throughput is
16.47% higher across these three workloads.

Measured runtime and physical turnaround:

| Validation | Measured runtime / payload | Exclusive GPU step | Submission-to-completion |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Real-model comparison | `1537.123534s` payload | `1567s` | `1577.462847s` |
| Formal GSM8K | `498.308875s` evaluation; `1260.085841s` payload | `1296s` | `1304.855984s` |

The comparison-request through formal-evaluation-completion chain took
`3572.044693s`. Exact result SHA-256 values:

- Comparison summary: `5ae0c17c7890e8decfcdf422538602b599019522fa279540989a9b5e0f1c911b`.
- GSM8K summary: `b06b71ca91a3cff7f4b11e027d2912c9ef4052e5195e311d3c203877414d9929`.
- GSM8K dataset: `3730d312f6e3440559ace48831e51066acaca737f6eabec99bccb9e4b3c39d14`.

The dependency's separate cold-L2 CUPTI kernel comparison and exact-head
14/14-job CI result are recorded in
[FlashInfer PR #4810](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/4810).
Those CI results belong to FlashInfer, not this SGLang PR.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from CODEOWNERS and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with comments or contact authorized users to do so.
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

Reopen the two or three you most want reviewed - a short active set moves faster than a long idle one.

Some directories moved recently, so an older branch may need retargeting:
`sgl-kernel/` -> `python/sglang/kernels/aot/`, `python/sglang/jit_kernel/`
-> `python/sglang/kernels/jit/`, `docs/` -> `docs/docs/` (`.mdx`),

+def apply_flashinfer_megamoe_cuda_graph_adjustments(server_args: Any):
+    """Keep graph captures inside the fixed rank-major launch contract."""
+    cfg = resolving_view(server_args)
+    if resolved_view(server_args).moe_a2a_backend != "flashinfer_megamoe":
+        return
+
+    graph_config = cfg.cuda_graph_config
+    decode = graph_config.decode
+    if decode.backend != Backend.DISABLED:
+        if decode.bs is not None and any(bs > 128 for bs in decode.bs):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "FlashInfer rank-major MegaMoE CUDA graph decode buckets "
+                "must be <= 128 token rows; larger forwards run eagerly."
+            )
+        if decode.max_bs is not None and decode.max_bs > 128:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "FlashInfer rank-major MegaMoE requires "
+                "cuda_graph_config[decode].max_bs <= 128."
+            )
+        if decode.max_bs is None:
+            graph_config = with_phase(graph_config, Phase.DECODE, max_bs=128)
+
+    prefill = graph_config.prefill
+    if prefill.backend != Backend.DISABLED:
+        if (Phase.PREFILL, "backend") in server_args._cuda_graph_config_locked:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "FlashInfer rank-major MegaMoE requires prefill CUDA graph "
+                "to be disabled; eager prefill uses collective-safe "
+                "fixed-128 chunking."
+            )
+        logger.info(
+            "Disabling prefill CUDA graph for FlashInfer rank-major "
+            "MegaMoE; eager prefill uses fixed-128 chunks."
+        )
+        graph_config = with_phase(
+            graph_config, Phase.PREFILL, backend=Backend.DISABLED
+        )
+
+    if graph_config != cfg.cuda_graph_config:
+        declare_resolution(
+            server_args,
+            "_apply_flashinfer_megamoe_cuda_graph_adjustments",
+            cuda_graph_config=graph_config,
+        )
+

+def validate_flashinfer_megamoe_model(server_args: Any) -> None:
+    """Validate the model surface implemented by the whole-layer adapter."""
+    if (
+        parse_connector_type(resolved_view(server_args).model_path)
+        == ConnectorType.INSTANCE
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "FlashInfer MegaMoE cannot validate weights supplied through an "
+            "instance connector; load an unquantized model from a model path."
+        )
+
+    model_config = model_config_of(server_args)
+    hf_config = model_config.hf_config
+    architectures = getattr(hf_config, "architectures", None) or []
+    architecture = architectures[0] if architectures else None
+    if architecture != "DeepseekV3ForCausalLM":
+        raise ValueError(
+            "FlashInfer rank-major MegaMoE is validated only for "
+            f"DeepseekV3ForCausalLM; got {architecture!r}."
+        )
+    exact_geometry = {
+        "hidden_size": (getattr(hf_config, "hidden_size", None), 7168),
+        "moe_intermediate_size": (
+            getattr(hf_config, "moe_intermediate_size", None),
+            2048,
+        ),
+        "n_routed_experts": (getattr(hf_config, "n_routed_experts", None), 256),
+        "num_experts_per_tok": (
+            getattr(hf_config, "num_experts_per_tok", None),
+            8,
+        ),
+    }
+    for name, (actual, expected) in exact_geometry.items():
+        if actual != expected:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "FlashInfer rank-major MegaMoE requires "
+                f"{name}={expected}, got {actual}."
+            )
+    view = resolved_view(server_args)
+    exact_parallel = {
+        "tp_size": (view.tp_size, 8),
+        "ep_size": (view.ep_size, 8),
+        "dp_size": (view.dp_size, 1),
+        "pp_size": (view.pp_size, 1),
+        "attn_cp_size": (view.attn_cp_size, 1),
+        "dcp_size": (view.dcp_size, 1),
+        "dwdp_size": (view.dwdp_size, 1),
+        "moe_dp_size": (view.moe_dp_size, 1),
+    }
+    for name, (actual, expected) in exact_parallel.items():

Thanks @yyihuang. Closing this because you have 21 PRs open and none updated in 7 days, over our soft cap of 5 for idle PRs.

Reopen the two or three you most want reviewed - a short active set moves faster than a long idle one.

Some directories moved recently, so an older branch may need retargeting:
